out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVATION:Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Chemicals stored on shelves above utensils and single use items.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with manager, chemicals will be moved to another shelf. All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Person in Charge will obtain a food thermometer. A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: There is no QUAT Test Strip on premises. The operator is not testing the chemical sanitizing solution to ensure proper concentration of the solution.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with person in charge who will obtain the test kit strip. The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device.
